metadata.body:
Documents context-scoping guidance for client and producer instrumentation. Application request-generation hooks and response/completion callbacks use captured caller context; library-internal execution uses the outgoing operation context where justified for propagation and suppression.

Prefers span boundaries that exclude application request preparation and response handling, while allowing temporal overlap when suitable instrumentation hooks are unavailable. Separates span lifetime from thread-bound scope lifetime and describes the callback boundaries to cover in tests.

The full repository-wide audit remains outstanding in #20958; this PR changes guidance, not instrumentation behavior or review-enforcement rules.
